title: Kedarnath: The Story Beyond the Temple
role: Idea - Motion designer - Design edits - Voiceover - Research
tools: After Effects, Claude, Eleven Labs, ChatGPT
desc:
Kedarnath is more than just a sacred temple—it is a place of faith, resilience, history, and survival.

This short documentary explores the stories, people, and landscapes of Kedarnath, presenting the spiritual significance and the challenges that have shaped this Himalayan pilgrimage.

Through real footage, interviews, and cinematic storytelling, this film aims to document the essence of Kedarnath while respecting its cultural and religious importance.
appr:
The idea behind that was very simple. My mentor or my teacher has given me the task of editing a documentary, so I have decided to make something on Kedarnath.

I have researched Kedarnath using AI, on my own, and on the internet, and I have collected all the visuals and the references. I have combined all of that in After Effects. Some of the clips are from others, but the motion design and the graphics part are mine.
cred: Some archival/news footage used in this documentary belongs to The Quint and has been used for contextual and documentary purposes.
